name: RD About Page

fields.label: Show the About Page
fields.description: An introduction to the library at /about, with a link to it in the portal's top bar. Untick to hide both.

fields.label: Label in the Top Bar
fields.description: The link to this page in the portal's top bar.

fields.label: Page Title
fields.description: The browser tab and search results. Empty: About and the portal's name.

fields.label: Description for Search Engines
fields.description: One or two sentences shown under the link in search results and when the page is shared.

fields.label: Headline
fields.description: The big title at the top. Empty: the portal's name.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.description: What the library is, whose books these are and who it is for. Text, headings, images and links.

fields.label: Image
fields.description: Optional: a picture beside the introduction (a book, a reading room, your logo).

fields.label: Show Live Numbers
fields.description: How many books, pages of text, collections and languages the library has, counted as visitors see them.

fields.label: Main Button
fields.description: The large button under the introduction.

fields.label: Second Button
fields.description: Optional: a second, plainer button. Empty: none.

fields.label: How to Use It
fields.description: Numbered steps that show a first-time visitor how to use the library.

fields.label: Highlights
fields.description: Cards for what makes the library useful: full-text search, citations, collections, partners.

fields.label: Show Featured Collections
fields.description: The collections marked Featured, as on the library's home page.

fields.label: More
fields.description: Anything else, written freely: the story of the collection, partners and funders, contact, credits.

fields.label: Content
fields.description: Text, headings, lists, images and links, shown after the steps and cards.

description: The portal's introduction page at /about: what the library is and how to use it, with a link to /library.
